meta.note_zh: 对照关系用于建立「神经机制 → 工程实现」的直觉映射，不是一一对应的物理等价；每行左列均可跳到站内词条。
meta.note_en: The pairings build intuition from neural mechanism to engineering implementation; they are not physical equivalences. Every left-column item links to an on-site term.

groups.desc_zh: 神经电活动的物理特性，决定了采集链路要什么样的带宽、增益与噪声指标。
groups.desc_en: The physics of neural electrical activity sets the bandwidth, gain and noise requirements of the acquisition chain.

rows.note_zh: 动作电位时程约 1–2 ms、含高频成分，胞外记录常用 20–30 kHz 采样；采样率不足会直接削掉峰电位波形。
rows.note_en: Action potentials last ~1–2 ms and contain high frequencies; extracellular recording typically samples at 20–30 kHz. Too low a rate clips the spike waveform.

rows.note_zh: 跨膜电位约 −70 mV，而头皮外信号只有微伏级；高输入阻抗与高共模抑制比（CMRR）是把信号从工频干扰里救出来的前提。
rows.note_en: Transmembrane potential is about −70 mV while scalp signals are microvolts; high input impedance and common-mode rejection are prerequisites for recovering signal from line noise.

rows.eng_zh: 低噪声放大与带通滤波
rows.note_zh: 突触后电位是较慢的 graded 信号，对应 0.1–40 Hz 左右的带通窗口；滤波器截止频率选错会把慢电位和峰电位一起滤掉。
rows.note_en: Postsynaptic potentials are slower graded signals matched by a roughly 0.1–40 Hz band-pass window; a wrong cutoff removes slow potentials along with spikes.

rows.note_zh: 有髓轴突把传导速度提到每秒数十米；工程侧的对应问题是端到端延迟——采集、解码、执行三段延迟之和决定闭环是否「跟手」。
rows.note_en: Myelination raises conduction velocity to tens of meters per second; on the engineering side the analogue is end-to-end latency—acquisition plus decoding plus actuation decides whether a closed loop feels responsive.

groups.desc_zh: 神经组织的空间尺度与免疫反应，决定了电极阵列的密度、材料与寿命。
groups.desc_en: The spatial scale of neural tissue and its immune response determine array density, materials and longevity.

rows.eng_zh: 传感器阵列空间分辨率
rows.note_zh: 感受野越小，所需的采样密度越高；电极间距大于目标神经元的感受野尺度时，空间信息在源头就已混叠。
rows.note_en: Smaller receptive fields demand denser sampling; when electrode pitch exceeds the receptive-field scale, spatial information is aliased at the source.

rows.note_zh: 通道对特定离子的选择性通透，对应传感器的选择性识别层； selectivity 不够时，多种离子会混成同一个读数。
rows.note_en: A channel's selective permeability to specific ions parallels a sensor's selective recognition layer; without selectivity, multiple ions collapse into one reading.

rows.eng_zh: 微纳加工与生物相容性封装
rows.note_zh: 阵列的通道数受制于布线、封装与散热；生物相容性封装决定植入后数周至数年的阻抗是否稳定。
rows.note_en: Channel count is limited by wiring, packaging and heat dissipation; biocompatible packaging determines whether impedance stays stable over weeks to years.

rows.note_zh: 植入体周围的星形胶质细胞增生与微胶质细胞包裹会推高电极阻抗、降低信噪比，是长期植入失效的主要工程原因之一。
rows.note_en: Astrocyte scarring and microglial encapsulation around an implant raise impedance and lower SNR—one of the main engineering causes of long-term implant failure.

groups.desc_zh: 把混在一起的头皮/皮层信号拆开：频域、时域与空域三条路径。
groups.desc_en: Separating mixed scalp or cortical signals along spectral, temporal and spatial paths.

rows.eng_zh: 带通滤波与功率谱估计
rows.note_zh: α 节律集中在 8–13 Hz，运动想象相关 μ 节律也在相近频段；先用带通把频段圈出来，再做 Welch 或 FFT 估计功率。
rows.note_en: Alpha rhythms concentrate at 8–13 Hz and motor-imagery mu rhythms sit nearby; band-pass first, then estimate power with Welch or FFT.

rows.note_zh: 单试次 ERP 被背景脑电淹没，锁时平均把随机成分压掉、把与刺激锁定的成分留下；代价是需要多次重复。
rows.note_en: Single-trial ERPs are buried in background EEG; time-locked averaging suppresses random activity and preserves stimulus-locked components, at the cost of repeated trials.

rows.note_zh: 眼动与肌电在头皮上的投影模式相对固定，ICA 能把它们分离成独立成分后剔除；残余伪迹再用回归或阈值法清理。
rows.note_en: Eye and muscle artifacts project onto the scalp with fairly stable topographies; ICA separates them for removal, with regression or thresholding for residuals.

rows.neural_zh: 感觉运动节律的空间分布
rows.note_zh: CSP 学习一组权重，让两类任务（如左手/右手想象）的方差比最大化，等价于用数据自动找「最有判别力的电极组合」。
rows.note_en: CSP learns weights that maximize the variance ratio between two classes (e.g. left vs right hand imagery)—automatically finding the most discriminative electrode combination.

groups.desc_zh: 从神经活动到行为：编码模型、运动学回归与闭环控制。
groups.desc_en: From neural activity to behavior: encoding models, kinematic regression and closed-loop control.

rows.note_zh: 编码模型问「刺激如何变成放电」，解码模型问「放电如何还原刺激」；BCI 用的是后者的逆问题，且必须在线、低延迟。
rows.note_en: Encoding asks how a stimulus becomes spikes; decoding asks how spikes reconstruct the stimulus. BCI solves the inverse problem, online and with low latency.

rows.neural_zh: 初级运动皮层群体放电
rows.neural_en: Population Activity in Primary Motor Cortex
rows.eng_zh: 速度 / 位置回归与群体向量
rows.note_zh: 运动皮层神经元的调谐方向构成群体向量，可直接回归手部速度；这是机械臂与光标控制解码器的经典起点。
rows.note_en: Preferred directions of motor-cortical neurons form a population vector that can regress hand velocity—the classic starting point for cursor and robotic-arm decoders.

rows.note_zh: 想象运动引起对侧感觉运动区 μ/beta 去同步（ERD）；工程上用频带功率作特征，配 LDA / SVM 做二到四类分类。
rows.note_en: Imagined movement desynchronizes mu/beta over contralateral sensorimotor cortex (ERD); band power feeds LDA or SVM for two- to four-class classification.

rows.eng_zh: 实时反馈控制与刺激参数自适应
rows.note_zh: 闭环系统按实时神经状态调整刺激，控制论里的延迟、稳定性与振荡问题在这里同样成立；延迟过大可能诱发振荡而非抑制。
rows.note_en: Closed-loop systems adjust stimulation to real-time neural state; latency, stability and oscillation are control-theory problems here too—too much delay can induce rather than suppress oscillations.

groups.desc_zh: 把单点技术做成可用产品：带宽指标、长期校准、审批与数据治理。
groups.desc_en: Turning point technologies into usable products: throughput metrics, long-term calibration, approval and data governance.

rows.note_zh: fNIRS 用 700–900 nm 近红外光测氧合/脱氧血红蛋白吸收变化；血氧响应慢（秒级），所以信息速率天然低于电生理。
rows.note_en: fNIRS measures absorption changes of oxygenated and deoxygenated hemoglobin with 700–900 nm light; the hemodynamic response is slow (seconds), so throughput is inherently below electrophysiology.

rows.note_zh: ITR 把准确率、指令数与单次决策时间合成 bits/min，是跨范式比较的唯一共同尺子；提高准确率往往以更长的平均时间为代价。
rows.note_en: ITR combines accuracy, number of commands and decision time into bits/min—the common yardstick across paradigms. Higher accuracy usually costs longer averaging.

rows.note_zh: 用户学习使用 BCI 时神经表征本身会变，固定解码器会逐渐失配；工程上要靠在线更新或周期重校准跟上这种可塑性。
rows.note_en: Neural representations drift as users learn to use a BCI, so a fixed decoder degrades; online updates or periodic recalibration track this plasticity.

rows.eng_zh: 医疗器械审批与数据治理
rows.note_zh: 植入式 BCI 按医疗器械路径审批（临床前、临床试验、上市后监测）；神经数据还涉及隐私、二次使用与「神经权利」讨论。
rows.note_en: Implantable BCIs follow medical-device approval paths (preclinical, trials, post-market surveillance); neural data also raises privacy, secondary-use and neuro-rights questions.
